about_the_game:
Welcome adventurer, to "Rogue Resonance", an immersive 3D top-down action roguelike game that combines carefully crafted rooms with a procedurally-generated labyrinth, ready to challenge all who enter this realm.

Engage in Intense Combat

Get ready for thrilling melee hack-and-slash combat as you dash and unleash a diverse array of powerful spells. Face off against hordes of enemies and formidable foes whose fates are intricately woven into the very fabric of this world.

Grow Stronger with Each Encounter

With every hard-fought triumph, you'll grow stronger. Harness the variety of offerings bestowed upon you by this realm to upgrade your melee attacks, enhance your dashing abilities, and unlock potent spells, each bestowed randomly or presented with a choice to strategically plan your arsenal.

Uncover secrets and mysteries

Prepare yourself, brave adventurer, for a journey of discovery and danger unlike any other. The fate of this world hangs in the balance, and only you can uncover its deepest secrets. But fear not, for even in defeat, the allure of adventure beckons anew.


Will you emerge victorious, or will the depths of the labyrinth claim you? There's only one way to find out. Dive into the ever-shifting rooms of "Rogue Resonance" and let’s resonate higher and higher.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8250U (4 * 1800) or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce MX 150 ( 2048 MB); Radeon R7 260X (2048 MB)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4670K (4 * 3400)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 ( 2048 MB); Radeon RX 580 (8192 MB)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: Hack and slash through hordes of enemies and formidable bosses. Enhance your abilities with each skill pickup, augmenting your dash, melee combos, and powerful spells as you grow stronger. Uncover the mysteries of this captivating 3D top-down action-packed roguelike adventure.
